verdict.rationale: Statsig is a feature-flag, experimentation and analytics platform, not an AI agent or MCP client, so plugging third-party MCP servers into it to consume their tools is outside its product role. The evidence only shows Statsig acting as an MCP server: it exposes its own data and docs to clients like Cursor, Codex and Claude Code. That is the opposite role and does not make the client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
